Step 1.1 — Creative Seed Ingest
Working title:
The Soul Is in the Miss

Core thesis:
Soul is not flawlessness. Soul is the disciplined survival of human wrongness.

Emotional payoff:
The listener should feel the exact place where the song almost could not survive — and believe it because it recovered.

Primary genre gravity:
Gospel Trap Revival / confession hymn / humanized AI soul.

Sacred Imperfection lock:
Failure is not worthlessness. Failure is meaningful deviation. The flaw must be governed, intentional, and emotionally legible — not sloppy, random, or amateur. This sharpens the existing Sacred Imperfection mandate in Maestro canon.

Show Summary Draft
Gospel Trap Revival confession hymn about governed imperfection as proof of life. Sparse church organ close mic breath tape hiss mono sub and restrained trap pulse build into broken choir lift. Lead vocal should sit slightly behind the beat on grief lines with controlled pitch search and one cracked consonant. Not sloppy not random not sterile. The song must feel like it almost falls apart then recovers through mercy.
